# A64 FP and AdvSIMD cases for tests/a64_simd.rs. The expected values were generated by running each
# instruction word natively on an Apple M4 (AArch64 with FP16, AES, SHA1, SHA256, PMULL, RDM and
# DotProd) with the given FPCR, after clearing FPSR.
#
# Fields, all hex: insn fpcr nzcv v0 v1 v2 v3 x0 x1 x2 x3 => v0 x0 fpsr nzcv ; assembly
# The vector registers are 128 bit values and nzcv holds the four flag bits. An input written $n is
# the value given by the line "$n = value" above it.
